Path: business reporting | dashboards.cube-query | P2

## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:services` · `area:reports` · `pm:queue` (`finding` removed — graded)

Triage: lands in `packages/services/service-analytics` (`plugin.ts:1084` on `origin/main` `a8bcce6` relays `defaultCurrency: f.currencyConfig?.defaultCurrency` without reading `currencyMode`; and the result-column resolution in `analytics-service.ts`) ⇒ `domain:services`; rationale: the spec's `FieldSchema` guidance says a field without a fixed currency uses the tenant default at runtime, but analytics faces show a `dynamic` field's `defaultCurrency` (the spec default is `CNY`) as an explicit column currency — and once objectstack-ai/objectui#10461 lands, field faces and analytics faces disagree. Runs but answers wrong ⇒ p2, the cube-query item's level (P2).

Triage seat #6015 · `session_01CRZSc7dU8oDStbTbSwhuZe` · 2026-09-25T04:55Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card (no comments yet) and `origin/main`. Dedupe over 1,113 cards (open, plus closed since 2026-09-18): `sourceFieldMeta` → 1 hit (this card); `currencyMode` → 4 (this card; #20090, the teaching-text sibling; #8345 and #20011, other questions).

Execution note: relay `defaultCurrency` only when `currencyMode === 'fixed'`, matching the renderer's rule; an explicit measure `currency` still wins. Pin both modes, and the no-mode case, end to end through the analytics result.

Claim: PM loop round 1
Session: `session_01Evb5jFDZGKQE9KG4jbMfMF`
Branch: `claude/issue-20091-analytics-currency-mode`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-20091`
Domain: `domain:services`
Seat: `domain:services#1`
File surface: `packages/services/service-analytics/src/plugin.ts` (the `sourceFieldMeta` currency relay, `:1084` on `main`); `src/analytics-service.ts` (the result-column currency resolution); new or extended test file(s) under `packages/services/service-analytics/src/`; `.changeset/20091-*.md`. ⛔ No `packages/spec` (triage: no spec change), no objectui. ⛔ Not `filter-normalizer.ts` / `preview-evaluator.ts` (#20040 in flight), not `read-scope-sql.ts` or the strategies (PR #20111 in landing). (Stop on breach; explain in the report.)
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (`dispatch-gates --tier`: no path-derived mandate, floor sonnet · default opus · ceiling fable)
Clause-②: no
Thread-read: 5826987344
Serial constraints cleared at 2026-09-25T05:49Z: the in-flight #20040 (`filter-normalizer.ts`) and PR #20111 (#20075: `read-scope-sql.ts`, `native-sql-strategy.ts`, `objectql-strategy.ts`) are disjoint from `plugin.ts` and `analytics-service.ts`. No open PR touches either file. The renderer sibling objectstack-ai/objectui#10461 is another repo.

 "pr_body_new": "Fixes #20091\nClause-②: no\n\n## What was wrong\n\n`AnalyticsServicePlugin` passes each source field's metadata to the service through `sourceFieldMeta`. That hook passed on `currencyConfig.defaultCurrency` without reading `currencyConfig.currencyMode`. `queryDataset` resolves a monetary measure column's `currency` in this order: the measure's own `currency`, then that relayed value, then `ExecutionContext.currency`. So a `dynamic` field's `defaultCurrency` showed on the dataset result where the tenant currency belonged. The spec says otherwise:\n\n- `CurrencyConfigSchema` defaults `currencyMode` to `'dynamic'`. Its own precision refinement treats `defaultCurrency` as the field's one currency only under `'fixed'`.\n- The `FieldSchema` guidance says a fixed currency is `currencyConfig: { currencyMode: 'fixed', defaultCurrency: … }`, and \"A field without one uses the tenant default at runtime\".\n\nobjectstack-ai/objectui#10461 changed the renderer's `resolveFieldCurrency` to read `defaultCurrency` only under `'fixed'`. The renderer reads an explicit column `currency` first, though, so the analytics faces kept overriding that rule.\n\n## Measured before the fix (commit `9a98c59b44`: base `fa00ebf447` plus the new test file only), and after\n\n`AnalyticsServicePlugin` booted over a real `ObjectQL` engine on `SqliteWasmDriver`, with the object registered on the engine. `ExecutionContext.currency = 'USD'`, and every authored `defaultCurrency` is `EUR`. Each cell is the result column's `currency` on the live path / the draft-preview path of `queryDataset`:\n\n| case | raw registration, before | parsed registration (`ObjectSchema.parse`), before | after the fix (both registrations) |\n|:---|:---|:---|:---|\n| `{ currencyMode: 'fixed', defaultCurrency: 'EUR' }` | EUR / EUR | EUR / EUR | EUR / EUR |\n| `{ currencyMode: 'dynamic', defaultCurrency: 'EUR' }` | **EUR / EUR** | **EUR / EUR** | USD / USD |\n| `{ defaultCurrency: 'EUR' }` (no mode) | **EUR / EUR** | **EUR / EUR** | USD / USD |\n| `{}` (parses to `dynamic` + the schema's `CNY`) | USD / USD | **CNY / CNY** | USD / USD |\n| currency field, no `currencyConfig` | USD / USD | USD / USD | USD / USD |\n| measure `currency: 'JPY'` over the dynamic field | JPY / JPY | JPY / JPY | JPY / JPY |\n| measure `currency: 'JPY'` over the fixed field | JPY / JPY | JPY / JPY | JPY / JPY |\n| non-monetary control (`number` field) | none / none | none / none | none / none |\n\nBold cells break the spec rule. The \"before\" columns are also in the message of commit `9a98c59b44`. The \"after\" column was measured on head `131de3a37a` with the same probe.\n\n**What \"no mode\" looks like at the relay.** `SchemaRegistry.registerObject` stores what it is handed and does not parse. A raw `registerObject` call therefore arrives with no `currencyMode` key at all. The declared-stack path parses first, which fills in `currencyMode: 'dynamic'`, and fills in `defaultCurrency: 'CNY'` when the author wrote none. Measured with `ObjectSchema.parse`: `{ defaultCurrency: 'EUR' }` parses to `{\"precision\":2,\"currencyMode\":\"dynamic\",\"defaultCurrency\":\"EUR\"}`, and `{}` parses to `{\"precision\":2,\"currencyMode\":\"dynamic\",\"defaultCurrency\":\"CNY\"}`. The fix compares `currencyMode === 'fixed'`, so both shapes fall to the tenant default. The relay supplies no default of its own.\n\n**Every reader of `sourceFieldMeta().defaultCurrency` in the package: one.** It is `enrichResultColumns` (`analytics-service.ts`, the currency chain). The live and draft-preview paths of `queryDataset` both reach it, and the same loop covers `__compare` columns. A grep over `src/` for `defaultCurrency` and for `currenc` finds nothing else:\n- `sourceFieldMeta`'s other readers take only `.type` (the compile gate at `registerDataset`, the time-dimension type, `measureResultType`) or `max` (`percentScaleOf`).\n- Dimension columns get only a `label`.\n- Drill metadata and dimension value labels carry no currency.\n- The package has no export face.\n- The cube face (`AnalyticsService.query` and its SQL echo) never writes a column `currency`. The suite pins that as measured.\n\n## The fix\n\n- `plugin.ts`: the relay answers `defaultCurrency` only when `currencyConfig.currencyMode === 'fixed'`, and `undefined` otherwise. The rule is decided at the one producer, so the one reader inherits it. An explicit measure `currency` still wins.\n- No reader needs the raw `defaultCurrency`, so no second key was added. The public `AnalyticsServiceConfig.sourceFieldMeta` return type is unchanged. Its TSDoc now says what `defaultCurrency` means there (the field's FIXED currency) and what a host writing its own `sourceFieldMeta` must answer.\n- No `packages/spec` change and no objectui change.\n\n## Tests\n\nNew `packages/services/service-analytics/src/__tests__/currency-mode-relay.test.ts`, 19 cases. Each case runs end to end through the plugin's relay, the real engine and driver, and the `queryDataset` result, under both registration shapes. Each asserts the live and the preview path. The cases:\n- fixed, dynamic, no mode, empty config, no config;\n- an explicit measure currency over a dynamic field and over a fixed one;\n- a non-monetary control;\n- two fixture controls: the shape really differs, and the live rows really came from the driver;\n- the cube-face pin.\n\nBefore the fix: 5 failed, 14 passed. After: 19 passed. The failures before the fix were the 5 bold cells above:\n\n```text\nAssertionError: expected 'EUR' to be 'USD'   (dynamic, raw + parsed; no mode, raw + parsed)\nAssertionError: expected 'CNY' to be 'USD'   (empty config, parsed)\nTests  5 failed | 14 passed (19)\n```\n\n**Ablation.** Every negative pin was ablated through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode, after the fix was committed. Each mutation was proven on disk: the anchor count went 1 to 0 and the blob changed. Each restore was proven too: the blob equals `HEAD` and `git diff HEAD` is empty.\n\n| leg | mutation | red |\n|:---|:---|:---|\n| A | `plugin.ts`: the pre-fix relay, which passes `defaultCurrency` whenever present | 5 failed / 14 passed: dynamic ×2, no mode ×2, empty config (parsed) |\n| B | `plugin.ts`: a relay that fills in the schema's `CNY` itself and ignores mode | 8 failed / 11 passed: dynamic ×2, no mode ×2, empty config ×2, no config ×2 |\n| C | `analytics-service.ts`: the cube face writes a `currency` on its columns | 13 failed / 6 passed, including the cube-face pin |\n| D | `analytics-service.ts`: every measure treated as monetary | 2 failed / 17 passed: the non-monetary control ×2 |\n| E | test fixture: the raw shape is parsed too | 1 failed / 18 passed: the shape control |\n\nLeg C's first attempt did not run.
